title: Sales Manager and Marketing Operations Analytics Agent

approval.note: A composed script is a draft. A human reads it before this film is published anywhere.

script.vo01: Managers build their view of the team by filtering spreadsheets, and the coaching conversation waits until the filtering is done. Opportunity progression over time is hard to see at a glance.
script.vo02: Market signals shift quietly, and by the time the shift is noticed by hand the moment to respond has usually passed.
script.vo03: It reads Opportunity and activity data, Team performance records. It engages you in Microsoft 365 Copilot and Teams. And it can assemble the team view without manual filtering, showing the reasoning behind every answer.
script.vo04: A manager asks where progression is slowing. The agent assembles the view across activity and opportunity records, and returns the pattern by account type rather than a spreadsheet to filter.
script.vo05: Asked for a plan, the agent proposes the coaching conversations in order of impact, with the evidence behind each one and the question worth opening on.
script.vo06: On risk, the agent names the segments where the sample is too thin to read, and separates the movement it can explain from the movement it cannot.
script.vo_payoff: Managers reach the coaching conversation with the view already assembled and the shift already visible.
script.vo_helps: The result? A coaching conversation that starts sooner, market drift surfaced in time to respond, and insight that runs continuously.
script.vo_cta: Get started on your agentic journey today. Talk to your Microsoft representative to learn more.
